title: Amit Shah 'ready to answer any question'; Rahul Gandhi says 'not interested in lecture'
content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah offered an extended parliamentary discussion on student protests.  He proposed sitting in Parliament from today until tomorrow to address concerns.  Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi rejected the offer, demanding accountability for alleged police actions.  Rahul stated the opposition seeks answers, not lectures from the home minister.

title: Dashcam captures Atiq Ahmed’s son Abaan’s fatal crash in Jhansi
content: A shocking dashcam recording captures the moment Abaan Ahmed's vehicle sped dangerously before crashing. The car lost control after darting past a pickup truck, resulting in a catastrophic collision that claimed the lives of Abaan and Sonu. Tragically, three others sustained injuries during their journey from Prayagraj to Jhansi, prompting police to delve deeper into the investigation with this new footage.

title: ‘I don't know who made the decision’: Ex-India batter on Bumrah's workload
content: India's growing injury list has placed the Centre of Excellence under scrutiny. Several key players are currently dealing with various fitness issues and injuries. Jasprit Bumrah's knee swelling has led to his absence from the Sri Lanka Test series. Former batter Subramaniam Badrinath clarified the COE's role in providing player information. He stressed workload management and consistent monitoring are crucial for player fitness.

title: 'Searched for suicide spots': Mystery deepens over missing Bengaluru techie
content: Search operations for Advait Upadhyay resumed on Wednesday with nearly 100 personnel scouring the hill. High-resolution drones spotted what appeared to be a body trapped amid dense vegetation. Advait went missing on Friday after setting out on a solo trek and informed his fiancée. Police are examining search histories relating to the hill and suicide locations. They are keeping all possibilities open, including foul play and alternate theories.

title: Ex-Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer changes how his $8 billion philanthropy works
content: Steve and Connie Ballmer are redefining their charitable strategy. The Ballmer Group is set to detach three regional branches, allowing them to operate as independent nonprofits. This adaptation is designed to align funding strategies more closely with the needs of local communities. With over eight billion dollars donated to charity, the Ballmers will shift their emphasis toward national-level initiatives focusing on economic mobility.

title: Standoff with Noel Tata: What led to N Chandrasekaran’s exit as Tata Sons chairman
content: The 63-year-old Chandrasekaran, who has been associated with the Tata Group for four decades, informed the Tata Sons board on Wednesday that he would not seek another term after his tenure expires on February 20, 2027.

title: IndiGo flight with 224 onboard makes emergency landing after engine failure
content: On Tuesday night, an IndiGo flight traveling from Kolkata to Chennai encountered a left-engine failure, prompting the pilot to declare a full emergency before landing. Emergency protocols were enacted to facilitate the plane's safe arrival with 224 passengers aboard, ultimately resulting in a secure landing on Runway 25. Post-landing, airport operations returned to normal immediately.

title: 'Raped, whipped with belt': Nagpur girl held under 'digital arrest' for 3 mths before assault
content: A Thane youth allegedly kept a 16-year-old girl under digital arrest for three months.  He controlled her using mobile access, threats, and constant video calls.  The girl was held hostage, raped, and inflicted with multiple knife wounds.  Police rescued her after her parents filed a missing person complaint.  Investigators traced assault items to local pet shops.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees
content: Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings.

title: Wife has MBA, rental and FD income; Delhi HC reduces monthly maintenance to Rs 25,000
content: The Delhi high court reduced a husband's interim maintenance payment.  The wife is well-qualified and has her own rental income.  She also receives interest from fixed deposits each month.  The court considered the husband's financial responsibilities for their children.  This decision adjusted the monthly payment from thirty thousand to twenty-five thousand rupees.

title: Mexico clears 100,000 tons of sargassum as seaweed crisis hits tourism
content: In 2026, a massive expanse of Sargassum seaweed has taken over the Atlantic Ocean, wreaking havoc on coastal areas. Mexico is facing an unprecedented surge in seaweed accumulation, which is damaging its tourism sector. The foul odor has led to a notable decline in visitors, leaving local businesses in distress. Though scientists predict improvement by late autumn, a permanent solution is still unknown.

title: Mamdani's regulation that 'angered' Amazon may impose an extra $664 per year fee
content: Mayor Zohran Mamdani backs a bill requiring delivery firms to directly employ drivers. This legislation faces opposition from companies like Amazon, which warns of job losses. Critics argue the direct-hire mandate will eliminate small businesses and raise consumer prices. Separately, Mamdani issued notices to retailers over illegal e-bike sales. The city aims to enhance public safety by addressing dangerous devices.

title: Bruce Springsteen’s E Street Band drummer sells 33k-sq-ft Palm Beach land for $13m

These adjoining plots encompass more than 33,000 square feet, boasting extensive frontage along the Intracoastal Waterway. The properties were sold swiftly and discreetly to a buyer who remains unidentified. This transaction underscores the robust appetite for expansive waterfront estates in Palm Beach County.

title: How Jason Kelce’s four daughters changed his life beyond football

The former Philadelphia Eagles star says his children often teach him valuable lessons when he believes he is teaching them. Jason and Kylie Kelce focus on teamwork, confidence, family values and keeping their daughters grounded. For Jason, becoming a “girl dad” has created a meaningful chapter beyond football and reshaped his definition of success.

title: How Caitlin Clark turned a childhood memory into a 22,000-book impact

This program aims to distribute 22,000 books to young readers in Iowa and Indiana, focusing on children from pre-K to eighth grade to enhance their reading abilities. Inspired by her own experience with Scholastic flyers, Clark is passionate about making literacy accessible and enriching the education of thousands of children.

title: India-Afghanistan T20I series confirmed, Delhi to host three matches
content: Afghanistan will host India for a three-match T20I series in Delhi. The series is scheduled to take place from September 13 to September 17, 2026. This contest will serve as preparation for India's Asian Games squad. Players will get valuable T20I game time and assess combinations. The Asian Games cricket competition begins later in September 2026.

title: Praggnanandhaa beats Sindarov to share Sinquefield Cup lead

This triumph is a significant addition to his success, having recently clinched the Grand Chess Tour St Louis Rapid and Blitz title. title: 6 killed, 2 injured after landslide hits Mumbai’s Kurla; several feared trapped

Fire brigade and police teams have arrived at the scene to assist with the rescue operations. There are concerns for the safety of numerous individuals believed to be trapped beneath the rubble. Authorities are eagerly awaiting updates to assess the full scale of the disaster.

title: 'I would be very worried': Ex-Sri Lankan cricketer names India's biggest weapon

Maharoof also highlighted Rishabh Pant as a significant threat to the Sri Lankan team.  Pant's ability to change games quickly worries the former player immensely.  Sri Lanka expects to counter Pant with significant spin bowling options.

title: 'Difficult for Pakistan to handle': Shoaib Akhtar warns Babar Azam-led side

Pakistan's track record in overseas matches has shown they struggle with adapting to different conditions, which complicates their World Test Championship ambitions. Babar Azam is set to lead the team as captain during this demanding tour.

title: Russia appoints former CJI DY Chandrachud as arbitrator in Ukraine's Oschadbank case

This arbitration concerns Ukrainian bank Oschadbank's claims regarding lost assets in four regions. The dispute arises from Russian military actions and follows an earlier Crimea-related arbitration. Justice Chandrachud previously declined similar appointments from Russia. A three-member tribunal will now hear this significant investment treaty case.

title: Why US is questioning Pakistan's Rs 3 trillion defence spending
content: The US State Department has flagged Pakistan's limited oversight of military and intelligence spending.  Concerns were also raised regarding government debt disclosure and budget proposal publication delays.  Pakistan's defence allocation has significantly increased for the upcoming financial year.  The report urges greater transparency in military and intelligence budgets.  This assessment highlights ongoing fiscal transparency challenges for Pakistan.

title: 'Rare for a kid to say, 'I want to be an athlete': What India needs for a squash boom
content: Indian squash is enjoying a surge of attention, fuelled by Anahat Singh’s historic World Junior title and a growing pool of top-ranked professionals. But India's star squash player Veer Chotrani believes sustained success requires more than courts and funding. India needs stronger coaching, training partners and a professional ecosystem at home, while families must increasingly view sport as a viable career alongside education.

title: Passenger ferry catches fire near Bali; 106 rescued, 25 still trapped

The rescue mission encountered significant difficulties, due to tumultuous seas with waves reaching four meters. At the time of the blaze, the ferry was transporting 44 vehicles and 53 motorcycles. Such accidents highlight Indonesia's ongoing issues with ferry safety enforcement.

Disciplinary action and notices will be issued after a thorough investigation.

Six others suffered injuries that necessitated hospitalization. Firefighters worked tirelessly to extinguish the flames, which took several hours. Investigators are now working to determine the cause of the tragic fire.

title: Mach 5 and beyond: US plans next-gen hypersonic missile with longer range, greater speed

The goal is to achieve unprecedented advancements in speed, range, and durability for these weapons. While older systems transition to production, innovative designs are under scrutiny. Emphasis is placed on cost-effectiveness and the capacity for mass production to effectively counteract advanced enemy air defense systems.

title: 'Process can’t be unending': Supreme Court wants SIR tribunals in Bengal to work faster
content: the process cannot be so slow that the next assembly elections would be due by the time the appeals are decided . nearly 34 lakh appeals pending adjudication before SIR appellate tribunals against deletion of voters’ names in west Bengal . the Supreme Court decided to take stock of their performance and suggested they speed up their work . a petition complained about the slow rate of disposal of appeals by those whose names were deleted from electoral rolls .
